scope: Cache-hit fidelity against private same-schedule recomputation, not cross-route arithmetic promotion.
root_causes: Gapped BF16 prefix-hit suffix fell to native attention because demand gather inherited an optional contiguous-layout optimization default.
The numerical oracle rebuilt its suffix token-serially, comparing different arithmetic even when cache hit and private batched recomputation were exact.
BF16 demand gather buffers were not released by INT8-only teardown or lightweight slot-view close.

protocol.post_packet_repairs: CPU RED/GREEN covers capped allocation rounding and common teacher labels. These do not change the packet's default allocation, KL, top-1, or state; label-derived diagnostic NLL is excluded here.
